title: nixos/prosody: add config check option
reason: Applicable: real prosody module + wired test. Real diff (a) purely syntactically unwraps sslOpts/mucOpts from `{...}: {options={...};}` to `_: {options={...};}` (no semantic change), and (b) adds a genuinely new `checkConfig` mkOption (default true) plus a real Nix-level `if cfg.checkConfig then <build-time validation via prosodyctl check config> else <skip>` predicate.
targets_toml: single target prosody, cfg_ident=cfg, option_prefix=[services,prosody], watch=[checkConfig].
